snippet.title: OrbGuard - Official Gameplay Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772700/OrbGuard/
Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/KvZtDuFwHz
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/xmoono.bsky.social


Defend Earth against waves of deadly cosmic threats determined to destroy your civilization! In this Rogue-Lite Auto Shooter, you’ll place Celestial bodies and upgrade them to unleash chaos on your enemies. How long will you survive?
